critiques.claim: Validation occurs primarily through pre-release requirements document reviews, simulations, and prototypes.
critiques.critique: Modern SaaS/cloud products cannot fully validate requirements before release. Requirements are hypotheses continuously validated in production via feature flags, canary rollouts, telemetry, and SLO monitoring.
critiques.nuance: Pre-release reviews remain essential for safety-critical, hard-to-update, or regulatory software.

extensions.title: Topic 9.2 Continuous Discovery & Runtime Validation
extensions.summary: Hypothesis-driven delivery, minimum viable experiments, feature flags, SLOs, and drift detection.
